description: Lean bench build against the shipped Release build of the same commit, interleaved on one host (bench-config-parity.py, 3 pairs of 20 rounds of newTab, closeTab, splitRight, closeTab through action.run): 100 * (bench - release) / release of the always-on action.commit p50 per pair. Done check 4 judges the series' p50 against its max_parity_delta_pct. The bench takes the Release build as --app and the same commit's --config bench build as --bench.
not_measurable: the lab builds and fetches only bench and bench-checks artifacts (builds.py, run_story.py CONFIGS), one per run, and the runner appends only --app --tag --out; this story needs the Release build and the bench build of one commit in one run (--bench)
